'''Gelen''' is a leader in the [[Deathwatch Guard]].

== Activities ==
During the [[Last Battle]], Gelen chases [[Mat Cauthon]] around the [[Field of Merrilor]], attempting to have him sit in judgement, until he catches up to him at [[Dashar Knob]]. As he does, the enemy arrives, and Mat thus orders him to escort officers to their posts.{{ref/book|13|36}}

==Trivia==
*Gelen is named after Glen MacDonald, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
